svg.title: The actual jet Thom operator and its proper-cycle comparison
svg.desc: Right Haar density exp minus r dt dr is conjugated to dt dr by multiplication by exp minus r over two. The actual generators are H H equals minus i partial t and H G equals minus i times partial r plus t partial t plus one half. The additive then logarithmic Clifford order has positive Pauli grading. Changing to the geometric frame X,Y reverses the grading, giving negative gamma for the suspension-compatible two-step family and positive gamma for the index-normalized family. The supported outward normal symbol has grading gamma. Its Gaussian kernel is even with the former family and odd with the latter. On both K-degrees the proper-cycle comparisons are Psi Gamma mu Z Theta equals mu circle and Psi mu Z Theta equals minus mu circle. The trace-transfer and family negatives cancel to give the geometric Godbillon-Vey pairing.
svg.metadata: Original CC0 diagram. Propositions 13.6–13.7 and Theorem 13.8. Human sources: Connes 1986 Lemma 7.8; Connes–Skandalis 1984 §§1–2; van den Dungen arXiv:2006.10616 Theorem 3.3.
